issues.title: In-flight refresh promise is never cleared
issues.explanation: refreshing is set once and never reset. The first refresh works; 15 minutes later every 401 gets the same settled promise with the old token, so refresh never happens again. A failed refresh stays cached as a rejection forever, even after the user logs in.
issues.fix: Clear it when settled: refreshing = (...)().finally(() => { refreshing = null; }).

issues.title: Replay recurses without a retry limit
issues.explanation: The replay goes back through apiFetch, so a second 401 triggers another refresh and another replay. Combined with the cached promise this is an unbounded request loop. API-140 says refresh once.
issues.fix: Replay with send() directly (or pass a retried flag) and throw ApiError if the replay is still 401.

issues.title: Refresh failure falls through to the replay
issues.explanation: After clearing tokens and calling location.assign, the catch does not return or throw, so the code replays the request with a null token and loops until navigation happens.

issues.title: Spreading init.headers drops Headers instances
issues.explanation: Object spread of a Headers object copies nothing, so callers' headers such as Content-Type are silently lost. Arrays of tuples break too.
issues.fix: Build new Headers(init.headers) and call headers.set('Authorization', ...).
